FUNC.NAME: wire_declared_body_len
FUNC.ROLE: confirm len is exactly the declared frame size

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: wire_declared_body_len
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: static enum wire_status wire_declared_body_len(const uint8_t *packet, size_t len, size_t *header_len, size_t *remaining_length)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: WIRE_COMPLETE with header_len (2..5) and remaining_length when len equals header_len + remaining_length
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: no ownership transfer; packet stays with the caller
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: any other result means the caller returns WIRE_INVALID without writing *consumed

LOGIC.INPUT: packet with len bytes holding exactly one framed control packet; expect_type is WIRE_PACKET_PINGREQ (12) or WIRE_PACKET_DISCONNECT (14); consumed receives the packet length in bytes.
LOGIC.ACTION: 1) If packet is NULL or consumed is NULL return WIRE_INVALID. 2) If expect_type is neither WIRE_PACKET_PINGREQ nor WIRE_PACKET_DISCONNECT return WIRE_INVALID (this helper only validates the two zero-length packets MQTT 3.1.1 defines). 3) *consumed = 0. 4) wire_declared_body_len(packet, len, &header_len, &rl): if it is not WIRE_COMPLETE or rl != 0 return WIRE_INVALID (PINGREQ/DISCONNECT must declare a Remaining Length of 0. F004/F005 define only the encoding algorithm and MQTT 3.1.1 states no minimality rule, so every legal encoding width whose decoded value is 0 is accepted - 0x00, 0x80 0x00, 0x80 0x80 0x00 and 0x80 0x80 0x80 0x00 - exactly as wire_decode_header accepts the 5-byte encoding of 0; a nonzero decoded value, a truncated Remaining Length field and a five-byte (over-long) Remaining Length field are malformed, and a decoder never sees a partial frame because wire_decode_header reports incompleteness first). 5) If (packet[0] >> 4) != expect_type return WIRE_INVALID (wrong control packet type). 6) If (packet[0] & 0x0F) != 0 return WIRE_INVALID (the low 4 bits of PINGREQ and DISCONNECT are reserved and must be 0, MQTT-3.12.1-1 / MQTT-3.14.1-1). 7) *consumed = header_len, the encoded fixed-header size: 2 for 0x00, 3 for 0x80 0x00, 4 for 0x80 0x80 0x00, 5 for 0x80 0x80 0x80 0x00 (the whole packet, since the Remaining Length decodes to 0 so there is no body); return WIRE_COMPLETE. No bytes are retained and nothing is allocated.
LOGIC.OUTPUT: WIRE_COMPLETE with *consumed = header_len (2..5) when packet holds exactly the expected zero-body packet: type nibble == expect_type, flag bits 0, and a Remaining Length field of any legal encoding width that decodes to 0. WIRE_INVALID for NULL arguments, an unexpected expect_type, a control packet type other than expect_type, nonzero flag bits, a Remaining Length that does not decode to 0, a truncated or over-long (five byte) Remaining Length field, or a caller length that is not exactly header_len + 0. *consumed is only written on the WIRE_COMPLETE path.
INVARIANTS_USED: PINGREQ and DISCONNECT declare a Remaining Length of 0 (MQTT-3.12.1-1, MQTT-3.14.1-1, F042, F044)
the fixed header flags of PINGREQ and DISCONNECT are reserved and must be 0 (F003, F004)
the Remaining Length field is 1..4 bytes and decodes to 0 for every legal encoding of 0 (F004, F005); no fact forbids a non-minimal encoding
the consumed count is the encoded header length, so the caller drops exactly the packet bytes from the receive buffer (CR-LENGTH)
LOGIC.PRECONDITION: packet holds one complete frame of len bytes (wire_decode_header already reported WIRE_COMPLETE/total_len == len).
LOGIC.POSTCONDITION: no memory is allocated or modified; only *consumed is written on success.

WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: the type nibble must equal expect_type 12, else WIRE_INVALID.

WIRE_MAPPING.WIRE_FIELD: fixed header flags and Remaining Length
WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: flags must be 0 and the Remaining Length field must decode to 0 (F004/F005 algorithm, value = (b&127)*128**i summed over the 1..4 encoded bytes, malformed when a fifth continuation byte is required). No minimality rule exists in the facts, so a non-minimal encoding of 0 is accepted and consumed = encoded header_len (2..5); a nonzero decoded value, a truncated field or an over-long field is WIRE_INVALID (MQTT-3.12.1-1).
the type nibble must equal expect_type 14, else WIRE_INVALID.

WIRE_MAPPING.WIRE_FIELD: fixed header flags and Remaining Length
WIRE_MAPPING.RULE: flags must be 0 and the Remaining Length field must decode to 0 (F004/F005 algorithm, value = (b&127)*128**i summed over the 1..4 encoded bytes, malformed when a fifth continuation byte is required). No minimality rule exists in the facts, so a non-minimal encoding of 0 is accepted and consumed = encoded header_len (2..5); a nonzero decoded value, a truncated field or an over-long field is WIRE_INVALID (MQTT-3.14.1-1).

EXPECT.derivation: fixed header C0 = type 12 flags 0; Remaining Length 0x00 -> 2 bytes total
fixed header E0 = type 14 flags 0; Remaining Length 0x00 -> 2 bytes total

cases.note: nonzero Remaining Length with one body byte
five-byte Remaining Length field (F005 malformed threshold)

EXPECT.derivation: F005 decode: 0x80 0x00 -> (0x80&127)*1 + (0x00&127)*128 = 0*1 + 0*128 = 0, multiplier after two bytes 128 which is not > 128*128*128, so legal; header_len = 1 + 2 = 3 and remaining_length = 0 so consumed = 3. 0x80 0x80 0x80 0x00 -> 0*1 + 0*128 + 0*16384 + 0*2097152 = 0, header_len = 1 + 4 = 5, consumed = 5. 0x80 0x00 for E0 -> same value 0 with DISCONNECT type 14 and flags 0, consumed = 3.
EXPECT.note: no fact requires a minimal encoding, so these are accepted exactly like the wire_decode_header vector header_max_remaining_length_boundary ("30 80 80 80 00")
